journal_lines: Prey flushed from the tree line, across the ridge, into a cave seam. §oAll three asked for a day. Got one.
The hunt led through timber into stone. §oWood, rock, prey — each gave something. Everything counted.
Took game from the grass, ore from the hill, timber from the edge of both. A full day. A full bag.
Forest and stone and quarry — the whole range worked today. §oTired in the right way. Came home with everything.
All three tasks on one expedition. §oThe kind of day that does not repeat itself often. Brought back proof.
Hunted into the rocks, cut timber on the way back, pulled ore from the cliffside. One long pass through everything.
Three asks, one route, nothing wasted. §oThe kind of expedition you remember when the others feel thin.
Came back with §lore§r and §ltimber§r and §lgame§r. §oThe forest, the mountain, and the valley each gave something today.
